_comment: Filled in for any session that doesn't say otherwise, so the daily log stays short. `require` is the metadata every session should carry — log.py names what's missing, and --strict refuses to write without it. Edit this file first: everything here is a placeholder.
_geo: There is deliberately no location.geo. ingest/weather.py sends those coordinates to Open-Meteo on your first log, and a template that shipped its author's coordinates sent his weather to every stranger who cloned it, silently and correctly-looking. Absent, nothing is sent and log.py says so: `no weather: the session has no coordinates (set location.geo in config/defaults.json)`, and `environment.temp_f` stays on the `require` list below so the gap is named on every run. Add yours as "geo": {"lat": 39.8, "lon": -89.65} inside "location" — town level is enough, and it is the only thing here that leaves your machine.
